title: Visibility Observation
description: One answer-surface observation produced by audit-answer-visibility. This contract enforces the floor that the append-only public fixture already carries. Fields that skills/audit-answer-visibility/references/output-contract.md also asks for are typed but optional; see docs/contract-coverage-decisions.md for why they are not yet required.

surface.description: The answer surface that was checked.

status.description: Access state of the surface, for example not-live or reachable. Not checked and not present must stay distinguishable.

claim_state.description: The claim state vocabulary from docs/artifact-contracts.md. A visibility result may not be recorded as observed unless it was directly checked.
